title: ChatRefusal
description: Output contract for the chat-refuse prompt module: the turn could not be grounded, so it resolves to an honest refusal with a reason code and answers nothing. The citations envelope is still REQUIRED - a refusal carries it empty, which is how 'nothing was grounded' is stated rather than omitted (an omitted envelope is indistinguishable from a lost one).

outcome.description: The refusal family: no-data (nothing to ground on), refusal (the request may not be answered), block (the request never reached the model), flag (a supplied source was quarantined).

reason.description: Why the turn was refused, in prose, with no request content echoed back.

reason_code.description: The machine-readable reason code the eval fixtures also declare as expected.

citations.description: The citations envelope, empty for a refusal: a refusal grounds no claim.
